parameters: Sons of Sayunaa, Veridians are invading our homelands!\! The blood of our nation, the Caladori Mines, must not fall into their hands.\! Assault their base at Ezrum - and leave Sayunaa's defense to its women.

\n[8], some say Sayunaa does not even need an army, because nature will defeat any invader.\! There is wisdom in this, but the Sayunaari soldiers are accustomed to the deserts, whereas we will be at a disadvantage.\! But the mines of Sayunaa can bear incredible wealth - we would be foolish not to attempt to seize them.
We've also got Casamir's boys right next door to the west, headed our way and wasting no time.\! Many battlefronts at once, but many options...
Ragavi, the famous sword mistress...\| Please lay down your blade!\! How could you serve the Imperial dogs?!
Narima... you serve these Veridians, do you not?\! And you have left scores of our brothers and sisters dead...\! For that I curse your bloodline for a thousand years!

Cyrus...\| He came to us just after the Succession War. No one knows from where.\! The Duke of Ezrum had lead us into disaster, and the people were ready for a change in leadership.\! Cyrus made great promises...\! Security, strength, preservation...\! But now we spill our own blood for the Archaelus Empire.\! Narima...
Then raise your sword against them!\! The Nephilim Army has the strength to fight them. There is no longer any reason to bend the knee to preserve our people.\! Please join our cause, Ragavi!
...\| I will.\! Give me warriors, and I will cut down the false Cyrus and lift the shadow from this land...
